resources.string: How do you want to see your Pokémon?
Black and white, like the Glyph Matrix
You can change it whenever you like in Settings.
Hello there! Welcome to the world of Pokémon!
My name is Oak! People call me the Pokémon Professor!
This world is inhabited by creatures called Pokémon! For some people, Pokémon are pets. Others use them for battles.
Myself… I study Pokémon as a profession. And you\'re going to help me!
Leave your phone face-down and locked. Pokémon will appear on your Glyph Matrix, and you can catch them with a long press.
Take this: your very own Pokédex! It records every Pokémon you register.
Oh! I almost forgot to give you something…
For now, only Pokémon from Kanto will show up. Keep filling your Pokédex and other professors will want to meet you.
I\'ve saved my number in your Pokégear. Give me a call and I\'ll tell you about any rumors I hear.
Your very own Pokémon legend is about to unfold! A world of dreams and adventures with Pokémon awaits! Let\'s go!
Hi! I\'m Professor Elm, from New Bark Town in Johto. Professor Oak has told me all about you!
Hey there! I\'m Professor Birch, from Littleroot Town in Hoenn. I\'d much rather be out in the field than stuck in a lab!
Hmm… So you\'re the trainer Oak keeps talking about. I am Rowan, from Sandgem Town in Sinnoh. I study how Pokémon evolve.
Hello! I\'m Professor Juniper, from Nuvema Town in Unova. I research the origins of Pokémon.
Take this: the %1$s Pokédex. From now on, Pokémon from %1$s can appear too!
I\'ve saved my number in your Pokégear. Call me whenever you like!
Ho! You\'ve collected all four regional Pokédexes! You\'re a true researcher.
Take this Town Map. With it, you can choose which regions\' Pokémon appear.
Incredible! You\'ve registered all %1$d Pokémon. The national Pokédex is complete!
Take this Shiny Charm. They say it attracts shiny Pokémon.
From now on, shinies will be three times as common. Keep looking!
You\'ll find it in your Bag. Keep up the good work!
Hello! It\'s %1$s. I\'ve heard something you\'ll want to know…
Take this: the %1$s. They say %2$s won\'t show up without it.
Good luck! Call me if you find anything.
You\'ve registered %1$d of the %2$d Pokémon from %3$s.
There\'s still a lot to discover. Keep that phone face-down!
You\'re making good progress. Keep it up!
By the way, I heard a rumor…
I haven\'t heard any rumors yet. Grow your Pokédex and I\'m sure something will come up.
You need the %1$s Pokédex to hear about this one.
Only Pokémon from the selected regions can appear. At least one must stay on.
A gift from %1$s. Pokémon from %2$s can appear.
A gift from Professor Oak. Choose which regions\' Pokémon can appear.
A key item from %1$s. Without it, %2$s won\'t appear.
The reward from Professor Oak for completing the Pokédex. Shiny Pokémon are three times as common.
Shiny Pokémon three times as common
